product_scope: itpay is the single public Buyer CLI entry point, and $itpay is its user-facing Skill invocation. It covers services, railway planning and booking, orders, authorized purchased content and refunds.
title: Advanced Multi-Service Cart And Historical Checkout Recovery
purpose: Use only for an explicitly requested multi-service cart or a historical pinned flow. Normal selected services use the Skill purchase route.
when_to_use: The human explicitly requests combining several services in one Cart.
An existing Cart or historical Checkout needs recovery.

commands.success_signal: result identifies the canonical cart line and next contains one executable recovery or service command
service-backed lines route to services next; ordinary lines route to buy

commands.intent: prepare an ordinary official Checkout; no payment request
commands.success_signal: status is human_checkout_required and handoff contains only fields usable by the current Host
one Checkout handoff is returned; rerun with --resume after output or token loss

agent_rules: The Backend Cart is business truth; the current backend-isolated local cart state file only stores local recovery handles and explicit drafts.
Run the exact next.command returned by the CLI. Do not extract or invent a capability from a raw list.
Railway query and booking use distinct Service Executions for one purchase journey. Start another execution for an independent intent.

Only non-rail capabilities explicitly requiring delivery email may ask its purpose and value. Railway notification contact belongs to the protected checkout page with verified account email reuse; the Agent must not guess or collect it in chat.
A lost Checkout response is retried with the same Cart and persisted idempotency operation.
A normal selected service follows services purchase on its original execution. Do not introduce Cart as an extra tutorial or recovery fallback.
forbidden: Do not call ordinary buy for a service-backed Cart line.
Do not create a second Checkout when the existing one can be resumed.
Do not treat QR display as payment verification.
purchase_consent: Advanced and historical quote/cart flows retain the current quote-bound approve_purchase template and genuine matching consent. Do not bypass its exact quote or expiry. Normal new services use the Skill purchase preparation rule instead.
